tests.title: Count by tag

tests.title: Any kind (*)
tests.code: count of * x with x:amenity=library within Bremen

tests.code: count of areas a with a:amenity=school within Bremen

tests.code: count of ways w with w:highway=residential within Bremen

tests.title: By name (name index, whole data)
tests.code: pick * x with x:name='Dialoghaus Hamburg'

tests.code: pick 5 nodes n randomly using seed 7 with n:amenity=bench within Bremen

tests.title: Within a box
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within 8.78...8.84, 53.06...53.09

tests.title: Ordered pick
tests.code: pick 5 areas p with p:leisure=park within Bremen ordered by -p.area

tests.title: pick exactly
tests.code: pick exactly 3 nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Vegesack

tests.title: the (exactly one)
tests.code: the n in (nodes x with x:railway=station and x:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof') with n:railway=station

tests.code: count of nodes s with s:shop in [bakery, butcher, greengrocer] within Bremen

tests.title: Value not in list

tests.title: Missing tag

tests.title: or / not

tests.code: count of ways w with w:highway and (w:maxspeed ?? 0 km/h) > 50 km/h within Bremen

tests.title: between
tests.code: count of areas b with b:building and b:building:levels between 3 and 5 within Bremen

tests.title: String method
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=restaurant and n:name and n:name == n:name.upper within Bremen

tests.title: true / false
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench and (n:backrest == 'yes') != false and true within Bremen

tests.title: State on a date
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench on 2015-01-01 within Bremen

tests.title: On each year
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Bremen on each year from 2010 to 2024

tests.title: Per month (changes)
tests.code: count of nodes s with s:shop within Bremen per month from 2022-01 to 2023-12

tests.title: Deleted in a year

tests.title: Time field
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n.time < 2015-01-01 within Bremen

tests.title: before
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Bremen on 12 months before 2024-01-01

tests.title: after
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Bremen on 6 months after 2020-01-01

tests.title: Previous version
tests.code: count of ways w with w:highway and w.previous:highway != w:highway within Bremen

tests.title: Sequence A -> B
tests.code: count of way A -> way B with A:highway != B:highway within Bremen

tests.title: Versions of one element
tests.code: count of (pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof').versions

tests.title: Time between versions
tests.code: average of (nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n.version > 1 within Bremen).map(n => n.unchangedBefore)

tests.code: distribution of (nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Bremen).map(n => n.creator)

tests.title: Next version
tests.code: count of ways w with w:highway and w.next:highway != w:highway within Bremen on 2020-01-01

tests.title: Transitions
tests.code:
w = pick way w with w:highway and w:name='Am Wall' within Bremen ordered by -w.version
transitions of w.versions.map(v => v:highway)

tests.title: split … by … at
tests.code: count of (split (nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Vegesack from 2010 to 2024) by user at unchangedBefore > 30 days)

tests.title: Within a district
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Vegesack

tests.title: Within and not within
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n within Bremen and n not within Vegesack

tests.title: near some
tests.code:
libraries = * l with l:amenity=library within Bremen
count of nodes b with b:amenity=bicycle_parking and b near some _ in libraries closer than 50 m within Bremen

tests.title: near no
tests.code:
baskets = nodes w with w:amenity=waste_basket within Bremen
count of nodes b with b:amenity=bench and b near no _ in baskets closer than 50 m within Bremen

tests.title: Within a set of areas
tests.code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within (areas p with p:leisure=park within Bremen)

tests.title: overlapping
tests.code:
campus = pick area a with a:amenity=university and a:name='Universität Bremen'
count of areas b with b:building and b overlapping campus

tests.title: nearest (fixed place)
tests.code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
(nearest * l with l:amenity=library to s):name

tests.title: nearest by foot (fixed place)
tests.code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
(nearest * l with l:amenity=library to s by foot):name

tests.title: Sum of areas
tests.code: sum of (areas p with p:leisure=park within Bremen).map(p => p.area)

tests.title: Sum of lengths
tests.code: sum of (ways w with w:highway=cycleway within Bremen).map(w => w.length)

tests.title: closer than or equal
tests.code:
libraries = * l with l:amenity=library within Bremen
count of nodes b with b:amenity=bicycle_parking and b near some _ in libraries closer than or equal 50 m within Bremen

tests.title: near all
tests.code:
station = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
count of nodes s with s:shop and s near all _ in [station] closer than 500 m within Bremen

tests.title: near … by foot (network)
tests.code:
libraries = * l with l:amenity=library within Vegesack
count of nodes b with b:amenity=bench and b near some _ in libraries closer than 5 min by foot within Vegesack

tests.title: Path by foot
tests.code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
u = pick area a with a:amenity=university and a:name='Universität Bremen'
(path P from s to u by foot).duration

tests.title: Path by bicycle
tests.code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
u = pick area a with a:amenity=university and a:name='Universität Bremen'
(path P from s to u by bicycle).duration

tests.title: Path by car
tests.code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
h = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Hamburg Hauptbahnhof'
(path P from s to h by car).duration

tests.title: Isochrone 10 min by foot
tests.code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
(isochrone I from s closer than 10 min by foot).area

tests.title: Isochrone 2 km by bicycle
tests.code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
(isochrone I from s closer than 2 km by bicycle).area

tests.code:
net = graph of ways w with w:highway within 8.79...8.83, 53.07...53.09
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
(isochrone I from s closer than 5 min by foot using net).area

tests.title: Entropy

tests.title: Gini
tests.code: gini of (count of ways w with w:highway within Bremen per w.user)

tests.code: forecast 3 years of (count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Bremen on each year from 2010 to 2024)

tests.code: fit powerlaw to (count of ways w with w:highway within Bremen per w.user).map(g => g.count)

shop.count
